targetConceptFragments: دخترِ یکی از خواهرها یا برادرهای پدر و مادرم
mandatoryRegression: all accepted UI and supplemental static IDs, all whole-text-exact IDs, and all accepted strings with runtime placeholders or markup
runtimeBinding: all accepted strings with runtime placeholders, plus accepted lines in occupied-resident Yarn nodes
contextWatchlist: all four first-pass context watchlist IDs, including unresolved non-UI dialogue
hashFormat: UTF-8 stable IDs, one per line, final LF

photoContext.seed: every accepted source match, including matches already in reviewed closure
photoContext.sameNode: all accepted IDs sharing a source-inventory nodeName with a seed
photoContext.branchFamily: all accepted IDs in any <character>_Photo node family of a seed
photoContext.compiledTopologyGate: each selected named node must exist in pinned compiled Yarn program
photoContext.unboundRows: source matches with no nodeNames stay directly selected; no invented branch
